Juro now connects to Claude! The latest models from Anthropic can now work across your whole contract repository.

You know the drill. You're mid-flow in Claude, you need to check a renewal date or a liability cap, and suddenly you're five tabs deep in a folder somewhere.

Those days are done.

The Juro connector gives you secure access to your contract data, so legal, finance and business teams can find, analyse and act on their contracts without leaving the chat.

Ask Claude to:
- "Update the payment terms in our [supplier] contract and save the new version back to Juro."
- "Summarise our most recent contract with [customer]."
- "Give me an overview of our relationship with [counterparty], across every contract and amendment."
- "Show me every contract with a change of control clause."

Your contracts, working where your team already does.

Link in the comments if you want to see it on your own contracts.

posts.content:
London 🤝 Boston
Two cities. Two dinners. One clear theme: in-house legal is redefining its role at scale.

Last week, we brought senior legal leaders together to talk candidly about what it takes to operate in high-growth, high-pressure environments. Huge thanks to our wonderful partners at Emerald Technology for their support with this!

🇬🇧 In London, the focus was hyper-scaling global teams and markets.

How do you move at lightning pace without losing control?
Where does AI create real leverage? 
How does legal enable growth, not slow it down?

🇺🇸 In Boston, we tackled the operational realities head on.

Capacity strain. Burnout. External spend.

And the bigger question: how should legal redesign the way it works before  adding headcount?

Across both rooms, one shift was unmistakable:

▪️ Legal is moving from gatekeeper to growth partner
▪️ From reactive support to operating model architect
▪️ From absorbing pressure to reshaping how work flows through the business

The conversation isn’t “should we use AI?”
It’s “how do we use AI to strategically elevate the work legal does?”

We gained sharp perspectives and practical insight.

If you’d like to join one of our upcoming events, keep an eye on our events page - link in the comments.
